caaStory.title: Behind the experience
caaStory.intro: Compre & Alugue Agora (CAA) is a real estate platform that brings together different property-search needs, connecting people, properties and services in one experience. It goes beyond traditional property search, providing an environment that combines property discovery, relationships between users and access to services related to the real estate market.
caaStory.introContinuation: The product was conceived with different profiles and needs in mind, from people looking to buy or rent a home to professionals working in this market. The platform was designed to organize these experiences within an integrated structure, making features easier to access and navigation clearer and more intuitive.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: The main challenge was to organize a platform with different features, audiences and journeys into a consistent experience. The range of needs called for navigation that made information and resources easy to access without overloading the interface.
challenge.continuation: It was necessary to consider how property search, services, the feed and artificial intelligence features could connect in a coherent experience while respecting the specifics of each area. The challenge was to balance the range of features with a clear hierarchy, so each user could find what they needed and understand how to navigate the platform.

process.label: Process
process.text: The work involved conceiving and structuring the product experience, including the organization of features, navigation architecture and interaction flows. The structure aimed to establish clear connections between the platform’s different areas, making it easier to move between property discovery, services and other available activities.
process.continuation: The experience also considered different contexts of use and devices, with attention to the organization of elements, information hierarchy and consistency of interface patterns. The aim was to create a foundation that could bring the different features together without compromising the product’s clarity.

results.label: Results
results.text: The project resulted in the conception of a real estate platform that brings different experiences together in one digital environment. Its structure includes property search, services, a feed and the IAgo assistant, conceived as a central point of intelligence and support throughout the user journey.
results.continuation: The navigation and interfaces were organized to make these features more accessible and provide a consistent experience across the product’s different areas. The proposal was to structure a platform for different needs in the real estate market, connecting search, services and relationships in one experience.

iruasStory.title: Behind the experience
iruasStory.intro: iRuas is an app focused on property search, rethinking how people discover homes. The idea is to broaden search possibilities, allowing discovery through different means: visual exploration of properties, observing the surrounding area, routes or text searches.
iruasStory.introContinuation: The app was conceived to bring these experiences together in one product, offering alternatives for people to explore properties according to their intent and context. Rather than relying on a single path, the search considers different ways to find and learn about properties.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: The challenge was to rethink the traditional real estate search experience and explore new ways of discovering properties. Instead of centering the journey solely on filters and text searches, the idea was to broaden interaction possibilities by considering different behaviors and situations in which someone might become interested in a property.
challenge.continuation: These modes also needed to come together in a consistent experience, with clear flows and navigation that made each search method understandable without making the app complex. The challenge was to balance variety with ease of use and maintain a coherent experience across the different modes.

process.label: Process
process.text: The process involved conceiving the product and defining four search modes: card interaction, camera, routes and text. Each was designed to offer a distinct way to explore properties, considering different intentions and contexts of use.
process.continuation: The interactive search proposes visual exploration through swipeable cards. Camera search brings the digital experience closer to places observed in person. Route search lets people explore properties along a journey or from a defined route, while text search provides a direct way to search and view results.
process.goal: Along with defining these modes, the work involved organizing flows, navigation and interfaces to bring the different experiences together in one app. The goal was to shape a clear, consistent journey in which each mode could broaden the ways people discover properties.

results.label: Results
results.text: The result was the conception of a real estate app structured around four search modes: card interaction, camera, routes and text. This combination broadens the ways people can explore properties, bringing different discovery methods into one experience.
results.continuation: The concept approaches property search from different perspectives, from visual and interactive exploration to direct search or discovery based on the user’s surroundings and routes. Rather than relying on a single mechanism, iRuas was conceived to offer different search paths within an integrated experience.
results.final: The project moved into development, carrying forward the proposal for a more flexible and varied real estate experience.

aboutPage.title: Design with strategy. Technology with purpose.
aboutPage.intro: With more than 18 years of experience, I bring strategy, design and technology together to turn complex problems into simple, useful and relevant digital products and experiences.
trajectoryBody: My journey began in Web Design and Front-end and grew into UX/UI Design and Product Design, broadening my view of how experience, technology and business connect.

Over more than 18 years in digital, I have developed a perspective that goes beyond the interface. My experience lets me consider both the experience of people using a product and the feasibility of implementation, the consistency of solutions and how a product evolves over time.
I have also worked with Design Ops and Design Systems, helping structure processes, organize patterns and create more consistent foundations for digital product evolution.
Today, I enjoy connecting these perspectives to turn complex challenges into clear, functional solutions built to grow.
visionBody: I believe good design does not start on a screen. It starts with understanding the problem and the decisions that guide the solution.
I enjoy organizing information, finding patterns and simplifying journeys. I value consistency, accessibility and collaboration across design, technology and business.

To me, Design Systems and user experience are not separate topics. They are parts of one view: building digital products that make sense to people, meet business goals and evolve without losing coherence.

I am motivated by turning challenges into concrete solutions, questioning the obvious and finding better ways to do things. Even after many years in the field, I still value curiosity, learning and the chance to grow with every project.
